distinguishing: Stella Adler, b. 10 Feb 1903 New York, daughter of Jacob P. and Sarah Adler (sister of Frances and Julia). Child actress in her father's troupe, then English-language stage 1920-24 and Irving Place Theatre 1926-7. The entry is truncated at 1928-9.
